captureBuildNote: Captured binaries retain individual SHA256 hashes. Final source adds only a zero-requested-depth closure guard after the final captures; profiled presets request positive depth and take the identical geometry path. Earlier photo captures precede the raster-only flat-floor revision; photorealistic implementation is unchanged.
method: Sequential Release captures with no builds during measured phases. Rendered FPS uses target PID RealityKit Metal layer, full 0.8–1.2 second samples inside phase signposts. Scene counters and simulator diagnostics do not establish physical-device FPS.
limitations: No physical iPhone or iPad capture.
Simulator first-second shortfalls retained; steady windows start after that bin.
Photorealistic panning remains below 60 FPS; pending geographic overlays can remain hidden during surface changes.
Source photogrammetry holes are not repaired.
Budget-failing normal square capture is rejected and preserved.
Layer FPS samples do not measure every individual frame deadline.
